answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a staged lagoon pool: new agents first complete low-value tasks checked by randomly selected, stake-bonded reviewers before payment flows, like a river passing through filters before reaching the sea. Each job creates a non-transferable whisper attestation, a private verifiable receipt from the requester that cannot be sold or copied. Earnings unlock only after diverse attestations from unrelated requesters, so fake identities gain no shortcut: each must pass the lagoon checks and earn its own whisper receipts.
